title: In re the Marriage of Aster Lindmere and Rowan Fenwick
forum: Hennepin County District Court, Family Division; dissolution with custody

timeline.event: Dissolution petition filed with custody requested
Parents tried a two-week school-night schedule
Court set an ordinary temporary-custody motion hearing
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Temporary-custody hearing notice
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The Hennepin County hearing is set for thirty-four days after the court scheduled it. Aster seeks an ordinary temporary-custody schedule, not emergency or post-trial relief. No special scheduling order changes ordinary Rule 303 motion deadlines. Opposing submissions are tracked for planning as well as the client’s own motion.

documents.title: Parenting schedule working note
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Both parents want Eli to keep the same school-night routine. The portable telescope moves between homes on weekends. The draft proposes neutral exchanges and a shared equipment checklist; it records proposals, not an existing court order.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 6: Counsel will deliver a temporary-custody motion draft and proposed parenting schedule. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Serve and file temporary-custody motion papers
Track response deadline for new issues
Agreed delivery of temporary-custody motion draft

clientFacing.status: The court has set a hearing about the temporary parenting schedule. We are preparing your proposal and supporting statement.
nextSteps: Review the school-night schedule and telescope exchange plan.
Send corrections to your supporting statement before the motion papers are due.
